title: kithctl SSE: frames without event: field treated as state events (wrong per spec)
description: watch.rs:346-347: the condition event_type.as_deref() == Some("state") || event_type.is_none() dispatches SSE frames with no event: field as state-change events. Per the SSE spec, frames without event: have implied type 'message', not 'state'. If kithd ever emits a keepalive comment or any non-state frame without an explicit event: field, watch_once will attempt to parse its data: as a JMAP state-change JSON blob and likely fail silently or corrupt watch state.
